titles.title: Grapes on White Dish
Grapes on White Dish Dark Rim

description: A white bowl with a dark brown rim holds a cluster of ripe, deep purple grapes. The grapes reflect an unseen light source. The bowl casts a shadow on the bottom right of the composition. Framing the central objects is a softly rendered white and gray surface that forms the composition's background.
title: Grapes on White Dish Dark Rim
